primitives.name: Counterattack Transition Probability
primitives.verbatim_quote: The purpose of this research is to build gender-specific, first-of-their-kind Graph Neural Networks to model the likelihood of a counterattack being successful and uncover what factors make them successful in both men's and women's professional soccer.
primitives.assumptions: Transition from defensive to offensive state occurs within fixed temporal window; counterattack efficacy depends on spatial-temporal coordination.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When opposing team regains defensive shape before ball reaches penalty area.

layer2.mapping: GNN node features (speed, angle) map to GSI Bayesian belief updates on success likelihood.
layer2.telemetry: Permutation Feature Importance scores for key node attributes.

primitives.name: Spatiotemporal Graph Encoding
primitives.verbatim_quote: These models are trained on a total of 20,863 frames of algorithmically identified counterattacking sequences from synchronized StatsPerform on-ball event data and SkillCorner spatiotemporal (broadcast) tracking data.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'G = (V, E)': 'graph structure with nodes V and edges E', 'v_i \\in V': 'player i at time t with position (x_i, y_i)', 'e_{ij} \\in E': 'edge connecting players i and j with distance d_{ij}'}
primitives.assumptions: Player positions and interactions encoded as static graph snapshots; temporal consistency maintained across frames.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Incomplete or inconsistent tracking data leads to frame omission or interpolation errors.

layer2.mapping: Graph kernel computes pairwise similarity between player configurations; used in GSE transition matrix estimation.
layer2.telemetry: Accuracy of GNN predictions on unseen game sequences.

primitives.name: Tactical Feature Impact
primitives.verbatim_quote: We show, using Permutation Feature Importance, that byline to byline speed, angle to the goal, angle to the ball and sideline to sideline speed are the node features with the highest impact on model performance.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'f_{\\text{speed}}': 'byline-to-byline speed (m/s)', 'f_{\\theta_g}': 'angle to the goal (radians)', 'f_{\\theta_b}': 'angle to the ball (radians)', 'f_{\\text{sideline}}': 'sideline-to-sideline speed (m/s)'}
primitives.assumptions: Feature importance measured via permutation; higher impact implies stronger correlation with outcome.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Low variance in feature values reduces predictive signal strength.

layer2.mapping: Feature rankings align with GSE decision tree branching criteria for optimal action selection.
layer2.telemetry: Model accuracy drop post-permutation of top-ranked features.
